deferred.reason: Needs a service worker and a script registration; pages are script-free by rule (AGENTS.md 7) and the shared UI kit cannot add a manifest link. Revisit when core/ui supports it.
Major platforms need PNG share images; a Worker without a PNG renderer cannot make them cheaply. Revisit when core offers a build-time image step.

Email subscription stores reader addresses and needs consent, a verified sender and privacy-page claims; the feeds (RSS, Atom, JSON Feed) already serve subscribers. Owned with the outreach sender setup.
Owned by the Ask and multilingual work (I18N-1).

gaps.feature: Index of every cited source with the entries that cite it
Field-by-field data dictionary page for the JSON and CSV
Per-entry revision history: what changed and when, with the reason
Versioned method page: what changed in the method and when
Compare problems side by side: gap, rank, solutions, evidence
Per-domain feeds of new and changed entries
Printable implementation checklist per solution from what it takes and first test
Frequently asked questions with schema.org FAQPage markup
